svg.title: Sector Soak cam templates — Author: jayis1
svg.metadata: Author: jayis1; units mm; 2mm plate, four layers at 12mm pitch; unvalidated prototype
svg.text: Author: jayis1. Black outlines=cut. Blue radius=sector 0 start. Raised radius=54; base=50.
Print 100%; verify scale. Bore 12; mounting 3.2. Hand-fit chamfers; never use sharp steps on a live head.
